features.title: How Smart Agriculture Portal Works
features.subtitle: For each farm you add, you'll go through these steps in order to get personalized, data-driven guidance for your crop.
features.desc1: Answer simple questions about your soil to get a health score and improvement suggestions.
features.desc2: See a list of crops suited to your season, soil, and water availability, and choose the one you want to grow.
features.desc3: Check live weather conditions for your farm's location.
features.desc4: Get irrigation advice based on your soil moisture and current weather.
features.desc5: See a month-by-month activity plan for your selected crop, from sowing to harvest.
features.desc6: Upload a photo of your crop to detect diseases and get treatment suggestions.
features.desc7: Get fertilizer type and quantity recommendations for your selected crop.
features.desc8: Get pesticide recommendations and safety guidance if pests or disease are detected.
features.desc9: Estimate your expected yield and potential income for this season.
features.desc10: Find nearby markets and current prices for your crop.
features.desc11: See predicted future price trends to help decide the best time to sell.

tips.rainy: Rain is active in your area — hold off on spraying pesticides, as it will wash off before working.
tips.hot: Temperatures are high today — irrigate early morning or evening to reduce water loss from evaporation.
tips.cloudy: Cloudy skies today are a good time to check crops for early signs of pest activity without sun stress.
tips.clear: Clear skies today are ideal for fieldwork like weeding, harvesting, or applying fertilizer.
tips.cold: Cooler temperatures today - a good time to check for frost risk on sensitive young crops.
tips.windy: Windy conditions today - avoid spraying pesticides or fertilizer, as wind can cause uneven coverage.
tips.default: Check your crops today for early signs of pest activity, especially after any recent rain.

codes.skipRainNow: Skip irrigation today — rain is occurring right now.
codes.skipRainSoon: Rain is expected in the next 2-3 days. You can skip irrigation - the rainfall should replenish your soil moisture.
codes.skipWaterlogged: Soil is already waterlogged. Do not irrigate.
codes.irrigateDryRainSoon: Soil is dry, but rain is expected soon. Apply a light irrigation now to protect the crop until rain arrives.
codes.irrigateDryHot: Soil is dry and temperature is high, with no rain expected. Irrigate today, preferably early morning or evening.
codes.irrigateDry: Soil is dry with no rain expected. Irrigate today.
codes.irrigateHot: Soil moisture is okay, but high temperature increases evaporation. Light irrigation recommended.
codes.adequate: Soil moisture is adequate. No irrigation needed today.
